about: VFX-LAB-4b · faction energy: the portal colour and the EXIT. exit "dissolve" is the procedural dissolve (lib/dissolve.js): the last ACT cell erodes bottom-up behind a glowing front in the faction's colour, embers rise from the front, faint smoke hangs behind it. Every key under "dissolve" is optional; lib/dissolve.js DEFAULTS fill the rest. Asura is tuned against the Kling clip's own dissolve (frames 89–120: magenta front ≈ rgb(231,109,186), hot pink-white core, pink sparks, dark smoke); Deva (LAB-6a) is tuned against Indra's own clip tail (f98–f120: the figure breaks into dense bright gold dust over the whole body, the cloud hangs, then drifts up and fades in ~0.9 s; no dark smoke) with the tuning knobs ember_density · mote_life · mote_size · mote_rise · mote_spread · mote_zone · mote_color · front_width · front_soft · sweep_frac · haze · canvas_cap · gpu_cap (lib/dissolve.js); Naga and Vanara are sane defaults until their first manifestation. fizzle_ms (LAB-4d) is a faction's own FIZZLE length in ms; a preset without it inherits data/manifestations.json defaults.fizzle_ms. Asura: 1500 (owner ruling 2026-09-13). "embers" (the shipped runtime's cardLand) is still understood but no faction uses it.
